name: CreateMonitorGroupByResourceGroupId

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic subscription to event notifications for the application group. When critical or warning events occur on resources in the application group, CloudMonitor sends alert notifications. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动订阅事件通知。当应用分组内资源发生严重和警告级别的事件时，云监控发送报警通知。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_subscribe_event

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic installation of the CloudMonitor agent for the application group. CloudMonitor automatically installs the CloudMonitor agent on the hosts in the application group. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动安装云监控插件。云监控自动为应用分组内的主机安装云监控插件。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_install_agent

parameters.help_en:
The alert contact group. Alert notifications for the application group are sent to the alert contacts in this alert contact group.

An alert contact group is a group of alert contacts and can contain one or more alert contacts. For more information about how to create alert contacts and alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html. For more information about how to obtain alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警联系组。应用分组的报警通知会发送给该报警联系组中的报警联系人。

报警联系组是一组报警联系人，可以包含一个或多个报警联系人。关于如何创建报警联系人和报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html。关于如何获取报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.name: contact_group_list
